scope: validate_constrained_ground loader hardening only; legacy validate_ground_plane behavior preserved

items.review: declared-valid artifact with fit_frame_group missing or equal to any validation group
items.fix: valid record requires a non-empty fit_frame_group and every region group distinct from it
_region_number rejects bool/non-numeric/NaN/Inf; non-negativity and [0,1] enforced for every present region

items.review: stored normal must match declared up_axis within the settings angle
items.fix: valid branch rejects when angle(normal, up_axis) > settings.max_angle_rad

items.review: d must lie inside the stored sensor height interval
items.fix: valid branch rejects offset_m outside [low, high]

items.review: fit_support_indices must be strict in-range unique ints (bool/out-of-range/duplicate rejected)
input_point_count missing/invalid; region indices >= count or over cumulative holdout cap
items.fix: input_point_count required non-negative int; region indices strictly in range and disjoint; cumulative sampled count <= holdout_point_cap
iterations >= settings.ransac_iterations and <= hard cap; iterations_cap <= hard cap

items.review: up_axis must already be unit; loader must not silently re-normalise
items.fix: _unit_vector raises on a non-unit stored up_axis; stored value is never mutated

items.review: must not only check one statistic bound or trust passed:true
items.fix: every valid region is re-derived: unique/range indices, count match, disjointness, RMS/p95/support thresholds

items.review: legal invalid/orientation_unverified diagnostics must stay saveable (not erased by competition_truncated)
items.fix: physical/independence gates apply only to status=valid; competition_truncated gate is valid-only; non-valid records only get type/range checks
